mechanism_narrative: WORKPLACES has climbed monotonically from -32.3 to -13.6 over four weeks, showing commuting routines re-forming; returning commuters restore weekday footfall in retail corridors, so mean RETAIL_REC over the next 28 days exceeds its last-28-day mean.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below its last-28-day mean even though WORKPLACES keeps rising week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: TRANSIT has recovered 5.5 points from -45.6 to -40.1; once the weekly TRANSIT mean crosses decisively above -39.0, transit-dependent discretionary trips resume and lift RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: In the weeks where TRANSIT first exceeds -39.0, the following 14-day RETAIL_REC mean fails to exceed the preceding 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: The joint decline in RESIDENTIAL from +7.3 to +5.3 alongside PARKS holding above -33.0 signals households shifting time out of the home into third places; when both move together this substitution lifts RETAIL_REC over two weeks.
candidate_trigger: RESIDENTIAL weekly mean falls below +5.5 while PARKS weekly mean stays above -33.0
failure_condition: In weeks where RESIDENTIAL is below +5.5 and PARKS above -33.0 simultaneously, the next 14-day RETAIL_REC mean is not higher than the prior 14-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Under a residual remote-work advisory with hybrid office mandates, WORKPLACES recovery stalls short of -10, so the commuter base feeding central retail stays thin; RETAIL_REC drifts lower over four weeks even as TRANSIT improves.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week gain falls below +1.0 point
regime_hint: residual remote-work advisory with hybrid office mandates
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean exceeds its last-28-day mean while WORKPLACES remains below -10 for the whole window.

mechanism_narrative: GROCERY_PHARM holding above +2.5 while RETAIL_REC sits near -13 signals household budgets rotating toward essentials; discretionary retail is squeezed out, so RETAIL_REC falls further over the next week.
candidate_trigger: GROCERY_PHARM weekly mean stays above +2.5 for two consecutive weeks
failure_condition: In weeks where GROCERY_PHARM remains above +2.5, the following 7-day RETAIL_REC mean is at or above the preceding 7-day mean.

mechanism_narrative: Spring weather sensitivity is visible in PARKS swinging from -20.7 to -32.9 and back to -29.4; once PARKS climbs above -30.0, outdoor leisure spillover into adjacent retail lifts RETAIL_REC within two weeks.
failure_condition: The 14-day RETAIL_REC mean after PARKS first exceeds -30.0 is not higher than the 14-day mean before the crossing.

mechanism_narrative: RESIDENTIAL has fallen in each of the last three weeks from +7.3 to +5.3, a monotone decline in time spent at home that mechanically returns consumers to out-of-home venues; RETAIL_REC rises over the next four weeks.
failure_condition: RETAIL_REC's next-28-day mean is at or below its last-28-day mean while RESIDENTIAL keeps declining week-on-week.

mechanism_narrative: The joint recovery of WORKPLACES (-32.3 to -13.6) and TRANSIT (-45.6 to -40.1) restores the office-to-retail trip chain; when both improve in the same week, RETAIL_REC over the next four weeks exceeds its trailing mean.
candidate_trigger: WORKPLACES week-on-week gain >= +5.0 points and TRANSIT week-on-week gain >= +1.0 point
failure_condition: In weeks where WORKPLACES gains >= +5.0 and TRANSIT gains >= +1.0 together, the next 28-day RETAIL_REC mean is not higher than the preceding 28-day mean.
